svg.title: VectorMatch raw backlog, all long-window W128 high-rate repeats

cc:Work.dc:title: VectorMatch raw backlog, all long-window W128 high-rate repeats
cc:Work.dc:description: Raw non-atomic queue_depth + in_flight observations, sampled approximately once per second plus terminal samples. Lines connect observations; they do not reconstruct unsampled peaks or exact queue conservation. Each panel has its own y scale. Dashed lines, when present, use the right axis and are raw cumulative client_not_sent, not server rejections. A bounded queue can plateau while commands are not sent. Finite-window observations do not establish sustained capacity, monotonic capacity or a bare matching-engine ceiling.
